subject: Keystone Analytics — DPA redlines and Order Form alignment
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@keystone-analytics.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: DPA redlines + Order Form questions (Keystone)

Hi Laura / Marissa,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attaching our proposed DPA redlines (see Keystone_DPA_redlines_20261126.docx) and a short note on the Order Form. High level:

- We’re ok with Redwood’s standard SCCs in principle, but we need explicit wording on the transfer-impact addendum given our UK/EU processing footprint.
- Controller/Processor: Keystone requests the Order Form to identify Keystone as Controller and Redwood as Processor for the specific telemetry data streams listed in Exhibit A; we’ve called this out in the redline.
- Subprocessor list: we flagged two hosting paths (EU-hosted vs global-hosted) and asked for the KMS / key custody options if Redwood expects the processor to host outside the EU.

Practical asks: can legal confirm acceptance (or counter-propose) for the controller/processor language and whether Redwood will add the transfer-impact addendum as a separate exhibit? If not, we’ll need an explicit fallback (SCC+technical measures) and an execution timeline.

Attachments: Keystone_DPA_redlines_20261126.docx (tracked changes), OrderForm_v3_Keystone.pdf

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Legal Ops | Keystone Analytics

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@keystone-analytics.com>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah.legal@keystone-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + Order Form questions (Keystone)

Samir — thanks for sending these through and for calling out the hosting paths clearly.

On Fri, Nov 27, 2026 at 9:12 AM Samir Patel <samir@keystone-analytics.com> wrote:
> Hi Laura / Marissa,
> 
> Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attaching our proposed DPA redlines ...

Quick summary from legal ops / contract side:

1) Controller/Processor language — we can accept language that designates Keystone as Controller and Redwood as Processor for the data categories you’ve specified, provided we narrow the definition of those telemetry streams in Exhibit A (to avoid scope creep). Marissa, can you run a short Exhibit-A redline that enumerates the streams and retention windows?

2) Transfer-impact addendum — we prefer to keep this as an exhibit rather than baked into the main DPA, to simplify future hosting toggles. We can draft a short Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) template that references the SCCs and a fallback mitigation ladder (encryption at rest + KMS locality + contractually bound subprocessors). Ben, I’ll need your sign-off on the fallback carve.

3) Timeline — proposed internal SLA: initial counter-redline within 48 business hours, technical evidence request to Security within 72 hours, aim to close legal redlines within 7 calendar days to keep the commercial cadence intact.

Next steps (action owners):
- Marissa: draft Exhibit A with exact data categories + retention (action: by EOD Mon, 11/30).
- Ben: review fallback language and KMS carve options (action: by Tue, 12/1).
- Laura: prepare TIA skeleton and send to Keystone for review (action: by Mon, 11/30).

I’ve attached a one‑page summary for Keystone to reduce back-and-forth — will upload to the shared Drive once I have Marissa’s Exhibit A.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: DPA_summary_for_keystone.pdf (summary page)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@keystone-analytics.com>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah.legal@keystone-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 12:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + Order Form questions (Keystone)

Laura / team — quick operational/legal note from my side:

- Clause 4.2 (Hosting & Export Controls) — acceptable if we add a short carve that prohibits export of raw EU telemetry without a TIA sign-off. That prevents surprise migrations.
- Exhibit 2 (Subprocessor routing) — we can offer two routing options on the Order Form: EU-only (small surcharge) or Global-hosted (standard pricing). Please let Sales/Marissa confirm which option Keystone prefers commercially.
- KMS / Key custody — Keystone’s ask for customer-managed keys is doable for Dedicated/Private deployments only. For Hosted we can promise envelope encryption + optional HSM integration (requires SOW + cost).

Commercial ask for Marissa: if Keystone wants EU-only hosting, flag the Order Form pricing line and I’ll compute surcharge estimate (approx +12–18% depending on throughput). If they pick global-hosted + SCCs, we’re likely to keep the current pricing.

I’ll review the redline doc in detail, but from a risk perspective the TIA-as-exhibit approach is the right move.

Ben Carter
Head of Product Security & Risk | Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.legal@keystone-analytics.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@keystone-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + Order Form questions (Keystone)

Laura — thanks, appreciated.

We’ll take the TIA-as-exhibit approach as a workable path; Samir and I will review the TIA skeleton when you share it. On the commercial preference, Keystone is prepared to consider the EU-only hosting option for core telemetry if the surcharge is reasonable — please have Marissa share the pricing line before we sign.

I’m attaching an updated, signed Order Form with our internal counters (OrderForm_v3_Keystone.pdf). If you can provide a redlined Order Form that reflects: (1) Exhibit A data categories, (2) routing option selected, and (3) TIA placeholder exhibit, we can circulate for final internal approvals.

Forwarding to our counsel chain for tracking — I’ll also drop the DocuSign packet here once we have the final Order Form.

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Nguyen
Senior Counsel | Keystone Analytics
Attachment: OrderForm_v3_Keystone.pdf
